<thought>The spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope: the M+1 peak is about 11 % of the monoisotopic peak, consistent with ~10 carbons (≈10 × 1.1 % 13C). No other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Thus carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
